SELECT
    g.SEC_SNAME AS `股票名称`,
    g.SEC_CODE AS `股票代码`,
    v.ENDDATE AS `报告期截止日`,
    ROUND(v.TA_TLIA, 2) AS `资产负债率(%)`
FROM
    GET_A_SEC_CODE g
JOIN
    VIEW_STK_FIN_IDX_PLUS v
      ON g.COMCODE = v.COMCODE
WHERE
    g.ISVALID = 1
    AND v.RPT_TYPE = '2'
    AND v.RPT_TAG = 7
    AND v.RPT_YEAR = 2025
    AND v.ENDDATE = '2025-12-31'
    AND v.TA_TLIA IS NOT NULL
    AND g.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
LIMIT 1
